description: I'm drawn to the design, storytelling, coding side of space specifically the human weight of hardware nobody remembers. I want to work on Abandoned but not Forgotten because it asks for craft over computation, real Apollo descent stages and dead rovers, told so a 12-year-old actually feels something. I care about illustrations, interactive narrative, front-end build, and I want teammates who'll argue with me about the ending.
summary: A game inspired by NASA's data, and the story of two rovers, who decided their own fate
details: It's an interactive novel, that walks kids through the story of the rovers, spirit and opportunity, and how they surpassed their decided limits
